articles.title: Did David Harbour Just Drop a Massive Avengers: Doomsday Spoiler?
articles.summary: Stranger Things and Marvel star David Harbour has seemingly confirmed a huge reveal from Avengers: Doomsday. Speaking with Variety, Harbour was asked to recite a line of dialogue from the upcoming Marvel blockbuster out of context.
body: " You... are Tony Stark," Harbour said, using the Russian accent of his Red Guardian character.

The dialogue appears to confirm that the inevitable reveal of Doctor Doom sharing a face with the MCU's Tony Stark will take place at some point within Avengers: Doomsday, and that Red Guardian at least will be present when it occurs. It's also, of course, a neat riff on Downey Jr.'s iconic "I am Iron Man" line — his final words as Tony Stark in the MCU to date.

While it seemed inevitable that the MCU's heroes would eventually discover Robert Downey Jr. under Doom's helmet, fans have been debating when exactly this reveal would take place, with some suggesting it would be saved for Avengers: Secret Wars.

Either way, it is surprising to see Harbour reveal this dialogue now, as it will no doubt be a key moment within the film. It's easy to imagine the shock that some former allies of Tony Stark will express on discovering the news, particularly among veteran Avengers such as Chris Evans' Steve Rogers and Chris Hemsworth's Thor.

articles.title: 15 minutes of Black Myth: Zhong Kui gameplay footage provide our first proper look at Wukong's successor yet
articles.summary: Game Science has delivered a gift for anyone eager to see and hear more from Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the sequel to the incredibly successful Black Myth: Wukong. The developer released 15 chunky minutes of gameplay, giving us a first look at combat and a clearer picture of the protagonist, the…
body: What stands out to me in the footage - having played Wukong - is a larger focus on fighting non-boss enemies. Wukong had battles in between bosses, of course, but its world was sparsely populated, focusing almost entirely on boss fights. This may still be the case here, but from the footage, at least, there appears to be more going on in the world.

The game's animations are very detailed and involve a lot of weapon entanglement - we see blades bouncing off each other and clashing, as if in extended parries. It makes that part of Zhong Kui look closer to something like Phantom Blade Zero - another Chinese action game with a focus on martial arts.

Speaking of bosses, we see one a little over halfway through the video, a large moth-like humanoid creature with shell-like wings covered in barnacles and scales. The protagonist fights a lengthy battle with them, eventually summoning a warrior companion to help, before directly taking control of them to deal major damage.

articles.title: Resident Evil Requiem on PS5 Drops to a New Low Price at Amazon and Best Buy of $54
articles.summary: Resident Evil Requiem saw a great discount during this year's Prime Day sale event when physical versions hit $56. However, in a nice little surprise between sale events, its PS5 copy is currently on sale for less than that at Amazon and Best Buy.
body: Unfortunately, this offer only applies to the PS5 copy of the game. But if that's exactly what you were hoping to get, it's a solid deal to jump on that saves you $16 compared to paying full price. It's also worth noting that the Best Buy copy is sold by a third party, antonline, but they have a glowing 4.06 star rating with 807 ratings to back them up.

If you're a Resident Evil fan, or are just curious about this new release, Requiem is well worth picking up to play through. It balances survival horror and action as you step into the shoes of Grace and Leon to experience a terrifying new tale.

IGN's Tristan Ogilvie put it best in his review: "Like the result of an experiment conducted in an underground Umbrella Corporation lab, Resident Evil Requiem successfully splices two separate strains of survival horror together into the one highly infectious new mutation."

If you're hoping to pick up Requiem for PC instead, you're actually in luck: Fanatical's Summer Sale is still going on right now and features the game for $57.39, so you can grab it for your Steam library for a little less.

articles.title: Insidious: A Guide to the Most Menacing Ghosts of the Series
articles.summary: A guide to the most menacing ghosts from the Insidious films: Know your demons before they venture out of the Further.
body: The Insidious franchise is back this week with a sixth installment, Insidious: Out of the Further. In the series, The Further is a realm filled with ghosts and demons who haunt, torment, and attempt to possess the living. The new film introduces Gemma (Amelia Eve), a woman with the ability to bring demons into the real world permanently, which is a talent of great interest to those in the Further.

Along with the return of series mainstay Elise Rainier (Lin Shaye) — a character who died in the original movie but who has kept appearing via both prequels and the character’s spiritual existence beyond death — the trailers and posters for Out of the Further are positioning the new entry as an Insidious: All-Stars or Insidious Avengers of sorts, depicting several familiar creepy faces returning from the franchise’s history.

articles.title: 10 Funniest Far Side Comics About Cows
articles.summary: From 1980 until 1995, cartoonist Gary Larson wrote and drew the comic strip The Far Side. It was a single panel comic strip filled with non-sequitur, often surreal jokes mostly aimed at adults instead of children, which was unusual for newspaper comics.
body: That said, Larson did have some themes and types of characters he’d often return to. Dinosaurs, for example, were a big one as Larson would depict them doing normal human things like eating breakfast cereal (with a free kid inside) or smoking cigarettes (the real reason they became extinct, according to Larson). He also liked to explore the domesticity of prehistoric life through cavemen and to lampoon historical figures and moments.
Here, I took a shot at finding the 10 funniest-ever The Far Side comics about cows, though with so many to choose from, there's definitely some room for debate.

From October 16, 1981. The beauty of Larson’s The Far Side is that jokes could be very thoughtful and subtle, whereas others could be more basic, silly, and understandable by children. This one, with a cow realizing she’s been eating grass, is a fairly straightforward gag anyone can enjoy.

articles.title: Fortnite's New Season Is Here, and It Creates a Massive Video Game Multiverse
articles.summary: Chapter 7 Season 4 has been Fortnite 's most highly anticipated season launch in a while due to its main themes: hacking and video games. At long last, it is here. You can now jump out of the Battle Bus and land on the Battle Royale island to find dozens of players dressed as Sonic, items and…
body: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, also known as Fortnite Override, brings all sorts of video game characters into the popular Battle Royale. It all begins with the new Battle Pass, which grants Sonic the Hedgehog immediately upon purchase. Players who purchase the pass during the first week of the season will get early access to the Grace Crowne skin (Tier 60) and her Infiltrator style.

Other skins aren't from existing video game franchises, but definitely fit the theme, as they are based on various game genres. While some were expecting more collaboration skins to be included in the Battle Pass, they'll have to wait for them to become available in the Item Shop. Shadow and Doctor Eggman are the first expected video game characters to come to the Fortnite shop, but players will also eventually see characters from Kingdom Hearts, Pac-Man, Mega Man, Persona 5, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, 99 Nights in the Forest, Crash Bandicoot, and Spyro.

articles.title: GTA 6 leaker claims to have "full access" to the game, as Rockstar struggles to contain even more gameplay videos
articles.summary: Rockstar appears to be struggling to contain Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay video leaks for a second day, as the leaker responsible claims to have "full access" to the game. After being temporarily halted overnight, they've reappeared again with another seemingly real GTA 6 video.
body: The leaker apparently responsible, CyberLeek, had their account suspended on X yesterday, from which they'd leaked the previous GTA 6 videos. But today a new account has appeared, with the same name, picking up where that one left off.

Three GTA 6 videos leaked yesterday, and a fourth appeared moments ago, showing a biplane flying above a major city - presumably Vice City - showcasing just how large and detailed the playing area appears to be. Towering office blocks stretch up into the sky as highways bend and curve in spirals around them, and small dot-like cars drive along them. The radio is playing on the plane, which flies with no particular urgency or destination.

The video ends with the game's co-protagonist Jason shooting a rifle at a wall and leaving bullet holes in it that spell the word "leek", suggesting a link between whoever recorded the footage and CyberLeek - or that the leaker themselves is the one apparently playing the game in the footage. This aspect is underlined by the CyberLeek account on X, which claimed: "Yes I have full access to the game."
points: Rockstar appears to be struggling to contain Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay video leaks for a second day, as the leaker responsible claims to have "full access" to the game.

articles.summary: The saga of Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks is continuing, with the person behind the account allegedly showing off a video of them flying over Vice City in a biplane. Originally spotted by Insider Gaming, we cannot verify the legitimacy of this video as it appears to have been taken down from every…
body: As highlighted by comments on the now-removed video on Reddit, and described in the Insider Gaming article, the leaker known as "Cyberleek" reportedly shoots holes into a wall to spell out the word "leek." Intentionally misspelling the word "leak," given that that's the leaker's alias, is a strong indicator that they have the game itself. Previously, it was thought they were only sharing internal gameplay videos from Rockstar.

Insider Gaming reports that in the rest of the video, Jason, one of two playable characters in GTA 6, flies a biplane over Vice City during the day, showing panoramic views of Leonida, which is the name of the entire map. These include clips from a cinematic camera, and it lasts for approximately two minutes, before a jump cut to the aforementioned clip of firing shots into a wall.

This is the fifth GTA 6 leak to have happened this week, with prior examples including a screenshot of the full in-game map, and three other videos. One video shows Jason playing basketball, another features him driving a car at night followed by a fistfight, and the third has him tasering civilians.

body: Black Myth Zhong Kui is the second game in Game Science's Black Myth series. Their first action RPG, Black Myth Wukong, was highly praised for its beautiful graphics and combat animations upon its release in August 2024. articles.title: The Duskbloods gameplay leaks ahead of tomorrow's closed beta, showing tense PvP battles with guns, wolves, and velociraptors
articles.summary: A snippet of gameplay from The Duskbloods - FromSoftware's Switch 2 PvPvE action game - has leaked online ahead of an upcoming closed beta test.
body: The Duskbloods leak was originally and accidentally posted online by 4Gamer, and was uploaded to Bilibili (a popular social media platform) before the original leak was hastily taken offline. The video showed the final climactic brawl between the three top-performing players at the climax of a Duskbloods match, where players duke it out for the top spot.

For those wishing to avoid spoilers altogether, this is your warning not to read any further. We'd also recommend staying clear of social media for a while longer, at least until the closed beta goes live.

As for what we see in the leaked video, the action seems very fast. Players dash around a lonesome rooftop, lit by bloody red moonlight, and you can seemingly double jump, do massive aerial attacks, summon computer-controlled allies including wolves and rotund fellas in a little wooden cart, and more.

There also appears to be a temporary player transformation which looks to work like the dragon (and bear) transformation skills in Elden Ring and the Souls series. In The Duskbloods, this allows the player to turn themselves into a large velociraptor and dash for a powerful grab attack.

articles.title: Games Done Quick is a beacon of hope for the gaming community
articles.summary: If you read a lot of gaming news - or work with it, like I do - you cannot help but become a little cynical sometimes. 2026 has been a brutal year for the industry, following an equally galling 2025.
body: Games Done Quick, often referred to by its acronym GDQ, is a speedrun marathon dedicated to raising money for charities - most commonly Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières and the Prevent Cancer Foundation. Its main events run twice a year (Awesome Games Done Quick around the new year, and Summer Games Done Quick in June), and these are supplemented by more frequent mini-events that raise money for other charities. The single largest amount ever raised by a single Games Done Quick event, to date, is $3,416,729 - achieved by Awesome Games Done Quick 2022 Online. Given that the first ever event, way back in 2010, raised about $10,000, you can see how far the marathon has come.

"We initially picked the Prevent Cancer Foundation because we were interested in donating to a cancer charity, but we wanted to do something that was unique. Prevent Cancer Foundation doesn't just look for a cure; they look for ways to treat cancer before it starts. This is something I think could really help people now, even before we find a cure," explains Merkle.

articles.title: Silent Hill: Townfall's latest gameplay trailer reminds me why the series shouldn't have guns
articles.summary: Good news everyone: we've got even more Silent Hill: Townfall to help fill the void until its release. But instead of a short story or teaser trailer, we have 1 8 minutes of poor old Simon Ordell wandering around the abandoned (and increasingly hostile) town of St. Amelia.
body: It's the first extended cut of playthrough we've seen for Townfall, and it did not disappoint. The vibes, setting, and grotesque monsters all seem on point for a Silent Hill game, with the small exception of the game's firearms.

I don't think Simon's handling of the revolver was particularly disastrous. But after enjoying Silent Hill f, which had no guns, seeing Simon execute monsters in seconds reminded me why I prefer good old-fashioned melee fights.

I like suffering in Silent Hill games. I like being pushed to my limits, being put in almost impossible situations, and having to get up close and personal with the disgusting things I find wandering around in the fog. While there are never usually a lot of guns to be found, I still think they give players an easy way out of combat that can ruin the tension and fear from being constantly on the backfoot.

articles.title: The latest Windows 11 update is borking some multiplayer games, but Arc Raiders' developer has a quick workaround
articles.summary: If your games started unexpectedly crashing after getting a Windows update on or after August 11, you aren't alone. And Microsoft says it's looking into the problem. Microsoft reports the following "symptoms" popped up for "a limited number of games": The game application becomes unresponsive.
body: Microsoft has only confirmed crashes in Arc Raiders, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, and The Finals so far, but you can send feedback to Microsoft with the Feedback Hub app if you've also found a game crashing since the update.

Microsoft says it is investigating to see if the latest Windows update is responsible. As of right now, the only client versions that have reported crashes are 25H2 and 24H2, so 26H1 is currently in the clear.
But Embark, the developer of Arc Raiders, claims on Discord that the “This is a crash related to the file inpoutx64.sys, which changed with the Windows update" (via Windows Latest ).

If Embark is correct, it looks like you might have to wait until a future Windows update for this problem to be officially fixed. However, Embark notes that you can type ‘sc stop inpoutx64’ into Command Prompt, then type ‘sc delete inpoutx64’ and delete the inpoutx64.sys file from your drivers folder to fix the problem in the short term. We haven't personally tried this method as we haven't had any crashing issues, so do so at your own risk.
points: If your games started unexpectedly crashing after getting a Windows update on or after August 11, you aren't alone.

articles.title: All of the pirates in Hooded Horse city builder Corsair Cove hate me because I can't make them eyepatches fast enough
articles.summary: Stories of pirates are full of swashbuckling, daring-do, and grog. But Limbic Entertainment's city builder Corsair Cove reveals those hijinx are only a sideshow: logistics is the star.
body: To keep your pirate populace happy, initially they'll only need basic food, drink, and shelter. In time, though, they'll start asking for finer things, like leather boots, jolly roger flags, and turtle soup. All of which you'll need to produce by rinsing the resource deposits on your island. Keep them happy, however, and they will set out on the ocean, crewing your vessels, and risking their lives against the threats that circle your enclave.
As a fan of the Anno series, the first hours of Corsair Cove were enthralling, but the sheen did begin to rub off after eight hours or so. Right about the time my pirates started to hate me.

Want more? Check out the Slash and Samurai Armor Pack DLCs, available now!
